_about: The events (src/delivery/events.js; the plan: EVENTS-NOTES.md). events: the one-level events (the menu's Events group): an entry is a level's id, or { id, from, to, reward } (from / to: "2026-12-01" is midnight on the player's device, or a time with its zone; reward: { car, money, id }, given once). special: the special events, a series of stages played in turn: { id, name, short, from, to, repeat, prize: { car }, stages: [ { level, from, car, free, clock: { good, evil }, ... } ] }. A stage plays its level's map as a level of its own (id <event>-<n>); car: the car it needs (owned), or with free: true the car it lends (a free try); clock: written out in full for the stage (never a share of the map's); any other field of a level overrides the map's. repeat: { every, live } (whole days) makes a RECURRING event: from its `from` (the first run's start) it is on for `live` days every `every` days, for ever (or until its `to`); between runs it stays listed ('Next in ...') with its stages shut, and a stage done is open again (played again and again). days: [ { car, tasks: [ { stars, side, car, featured, maxed, packs, limit, key } ] } ] (with repeat, one a day of a run) makes a ROTATING event (the Concept Strike): each day a run of its own, its car a free try at the player's own ECU, its tasks paying that day's pack (packs.json givenBy.event.day) up to their limits a day, or the featured car's key (events.js head). The card packs an event gives, and their featured cards, are the PACK's (packs.json: a pack names its event with `event` and what gives it with `givenBy`; one definition per pack, CHECKLIST 159): an event names nothing about packs. Check: node scripts/events.mjs check.

special.name: Car Hunt
special.title: Car Hunt: Blower Tourer
special._note: The owner, 13-Oct: a recurring event, infinitely grindable: every delivery of its stage while it is on gives one Car Hunt pack (packs.json car-hunt-special, givenBy.event.every), whose featured card is the Blower Tourer. Its stage is Back Roads (normally 115 s Good / 90 s Evil), driven only in a car of the hunt car's stars (the owner: 'same-starred cars'; the Blower Tourer is 3 stars: allowedCars tiers [3], both sides). The clock of 300 s on both sides is a TESTING CAP (the owner: 'The 5 min cap is just for testing'): tighten it later, in the stage's clock below.

special.name: Concept Strike
special.title: Concept Strike
special._note: The owner, 13-Oct (CHECKLIST 211): a ROTATING event, Monday to Saturday (from Monday 12 Oct 2026, 6 days of every 7; no event on Sunday), each day featuring one of the six concept key cars (2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 5 stars), lent as a free try at the player's own ECU for it. A day's tasks pay that day's pack (packs.json concept-strike-<day>: its featured card the day's car), each up to its limit a day; delivering the day's car at its max ECU gives its key. Its stage is Back Roads (the Car Hunt's: the shortest road), any car the player owns (or the free try). The clock of 300 s on both sides is a TESTING CAP, as the Car Hunt's: tighten it later.
